messages:
kevin: Hey support — seeing weird outputs from prod since ~2026-02-15 09:12 UTC. We requested model redwood-7b but responses behave like a lighter variant: short responses, tokenized garbage, hallucinations. Request IDs: req_0a1b2c, req_0a1b2d. Region header was us-west2. Latency spiked from ~120ms to 1.5s. CC @maria

maria: Sorry to hear that, @kevin. Can you paste a full request + response body (sanitized) and one request ID we can look up? Any 5xx/403s in your client logs?

kevin: Putting a minimal repro here:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
  -H "x-region: us-west2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"Summarize the product goals in one line"}'
```
Response body for req_0a1b2c:
```
{"id":"req_0a1b2c","status":200,"model":"redwood-7b-lite","output":"Summarize: serving small var...\uFFFd"}
```
We also saw 502 spikes around the same time.

maria: Thanks. That snippet is super helpful. Are you on Hosted or Dedicated? Any model pinning / version lock in your config?

kevin: Hosted, no pinning. We didn't change anything in deployment. Billing team noticed a sudden token surge — looks like retries + slower tokens.

sam: FYI SRE saw an automatic standby failover at 2026-02-15T09:11:40Z due to region control-plane hiccup. Routing policy allowed fallback to compatible variants to keep latency under SLOs. ops-bot handled the switch.

ops-bot: [event] region_failover: us-west2 -> us-west2-standby at 2026-02-15T09:11:40Z. Fallback policy: variant_compatibility=relaxed, prefer_low_latency=true

jyoti: From infra logs: the model served had a different tokenizer/vocab mapping. Requested model hash abc123, served def456. Tokenizer header shows vocab_size mismatch (expect 50260 vs served 50257). That's likely causing garbled decode and capability drop. Also some quantization flags differ.

kevin: That explains the odd tokens and shorter outputs. Can we force pin back to original weights while this is investigated? We can't ship this to customers.

maria: Opening a P0 escalation to eng-runtime and model-onboarding. @jyoti can you attach the infra logs and the model hash diff? @sam can you confirm whether automatic fallback rules can be disabled per-customer or per-route?

sam: We can disable relaxed-compat fallbacks at the route level; I'll toggle for the kevin account and backfill a clean route to only allow exact-variant matches. Will DM the change id.

eve: (billing) If this is a platform-induced fallback we can review charges for the affected request IDs and offer credit. Please send billing ticket with request IDs and timestamp range.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Dropping logs to the DM thread now. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:

maria: We'll keep this thread updated with timeline and remediation steps. Next updates from eng-runtime within 30m.
